This account should now be yours

The day your guardian named as the handover has passed, so this account is yours now. They cannot hand it over themselves and we will not do it silently - write to help@support.pingolin.com and we will walk you through taking it over, including the recovery key and any passkey that would otherwise keep working.

Whoever set this account up knows its password, and the password is what decrypts your data — so they can see where you are now, everywhere you have been for as long as this circle keeps history, and they can set alerts telling them when you arrive somewhere or leave.

Nothing tells you when they look. There is no notification, no record you can read, and no way for us to show you one — checking a map leaves no trace.

When you turn 18 the account becomes yours and their responsibility for it ends. Changing the password alone does not remove their access, because a recovery key or a passkey they registered keeps working. Section 6 of the Terms has the steps.

If asking them is not safe, do not ask. You can write to abuse@mail.pingolin.com instead — a minor may report an account held by a guardian, and so may an adult about one a guardian set up for them.
